user.title: Set up HA Chat
user.description: Select the users who may use the chat.

data.push_enabled: Push notifications via the Companion app
data.dashboard_path: Dashboard path of the chat card (fallback only – the card reports its dashboard automatically)
data.fire_events: Fire "ha_chat_message" event for automations (message text is visible to administrators in automations)

error.no_users: Please select at least one user.

abort.single_instance_allowed: HA Chat is already set up.

data.push_enabled: Push notifications via the Companion app
data.dashboard_path: Dashboard path of the chat card (fallback only – the card reports its dashboard automatically)
data.fire_events: Fire "ha_chat_message" event for automations (message text is visible to administrators in automations)

error.no_users: Please select at least one user.

send_message.name: Send chat message
send_message.description: Sends a message as "Home" to a conversation (default: channel "Home").

conversation.name: Conversation
conversation.description: Name or ID. Empty = channel Home.

user.name: User
user.description: Instead of a conversation: display name (first name is enough), user ID or person (person.xyz). The message goes to this user's personal channel "Home – Messages", which only they can see.

file.name: File
file.description: Path to a file (must be allowed in allowlist_external_dirs).

buttons.name: Answer buttons
buttons.description: List of buttons, e.g. ["Yes", "No"], or entries with title, action and confirm (asks e.g. "Sure?" before the press counts). A press fires the "ha_chat_button" event.

important.name: Highest priority
important.description: Breaks through Focus/Do Not Disturb on iPhone (time-sensitive) and uses the Android channel "Chat – Wichtig". Marked as important in the chat.
